facing.head: class
facing.src: art.draw facing (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {facing}): the side a drawn thing faces

expression.head: class
expression.src: art.draw expression (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {expression}, drawing.person.expression): a k.faces expression, or a word or k.feelings feeling that names one (figure-rules.sop)

pose.head: class
pose.src: art.draw pose (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {pose}, drawing.person.pose): a k.faces pose of the figure (figure-rules.sop)

trait.head: class
trait.src: art.draw trait (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {trait}): a k.faces trait (colours set, parts added or taken away)

wear.head: candidate
wear.src: art.draw wear (drawing.object.make / catalog.make {wear}): a k.wearables thing worn by the person made

edge.head: class
edge.src: art.draw edge (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {edge}): the side of the page a thing touches or is cut off by (occlusion-rules.sop)

cut.head: number
cut.src: art.draw cut (drawing.object.make / catalog.make / object.change {cut}): the share of the thing beyond the page edge (0 touching, 0.5 half cut off)
